title: Safety first
explanation: If you are in danger, call 112 now. Women can also call 181. I will not draft a notice while the story includes a threat of violence. A letter does not make you safe, and sending one can make an angry person angrier. When you are safe, come back with the money facts and I will draft the civil letter. If he has already hurt you or threatened to, tell the police. That is not this tool's job.
options: Call 112 if you are unsafe right now.
Women can call 181, the women's helpline.
After you are safe, come back. I will then draft a civil notice and still will not add a criminal threat to it.
lawyer: See a lawyer, or the police, before you send anyone a letter about this.
checks: Citations in the notice were checked against the sections retrieved for this story.
